Create ONE polished portrait Hangul Sori mobile STORY DIALOGUE screen, 9:19.5 portrait. This is the closing conversation after the first book has awakened Tal-Seonbi in the ruined Ildu courtyard. No learning exercise, question, quiz, progress, rewards or construction completion.
REFERENCE AUTHORITY:
1: Taego APPROVED BODY model. Use lower-left WELCOME's adult feline body, four-leg structure, long torso, tucked waist, hindquarters, large paws and long ringed tail. Not a bear, cub, toy or short round tiger.
2: Taego APPROVED FACE. Same broad feline cheeks, paired white whisker pads, short broad nose, white chin, small rounded ears, blue-gray irises and dark pupils; kind protective eyes, no human smile or big glowing pupils. Gentle direct eye contact to the player. One teal/gold three-curl emblem on anatomical LEFT chest.
3: Sujin APPROVED identity and whole costume: adult woman, brown wavy bob, gold stud earrings, teal textured blazer, ivory knit with rolled cream cuffs, gray-brown wide trousers, brown loafers, red book held securely.
4: Tal-Seonbi APPROVED identity: rigid carved wood Hahoe smiling mask, never a human skin face; black woven gat and cords, ivory patterned long robe, navy lining and underclothes, sage sash and tasseled ornament, traditional dark shoes and white socks, bamboo painted fan held firmly. He addresses the player warmly, extending his free hand naturally.
5: ENVIRONMENT ONLY. Keep the ruined stone courtyard, fallen dark roof tiles, small yellow flowers, worn low timber study table and old study book. Do NOT copy its character renditions, clouds, icons, logo or navigation.
STAGING / HARD ANATOMY PRIORITY:
Pull the camera back enough to fit all three entire bodies. Taego is on the left with long body extending diagonally into the available left/middle space; Sujin and Tal-Seonbi stand separately on the right. Do not crop the tiger's rump, paws, whiskers, ears or tail. TWO separate front legs and TWO separate hind legs must each visibly lead into their own FOUR paws. Normal far-hip overlap is allowed but all four limb contours emerging from the body and all four paws are readable. Preserve negative space under the belly and between legs. No leg may merge, bifurcate, disappear behind a person/table/grass or be represented by an unattached foot. All four paws have modest individual contact shadows on ONE flat stone/earth plane. All characters at comparable depth, NOT on raised platforms.
CRITICAL RELATIVE SCALE: Sujin crown 160cm, Tal crown170cm plus20cm gat, divine Taego shoulder/withers180cm. The TIGER'S SHOULDER must be visibly ABOVE Sujin's CROWN when they stand on the same plane. Do not only enlarge his head. Preserve body proportions. Give Taego more width and visual mass than either human, do not miniaturize him to fit. Keep all three full bodies comfortably inside the artwork, including shoes.
Sujin looks to the speaking Tal. Tal faces the player viewpoint beyond the screen. Taego also offers reassuring eye contact to that same player, neck and shoulders relaxed in the approved WELCOME pose, not staring down at Sujin. No invented player avatar. Dokkaebi and Joy are offscreen during this single-speaker cut.
KEEP THE EXISTING STUDY TABLE AND BOOK IN THE COURTYARD. The camera sees the low table in the lower foreground BELOW the projected position of all four tiger paws and human shoes: it must not occlude any leg. Do not move the book into Tal's hands or invent a second stand. Open old study book: LEFT page contains only the already restored Korean glyph '아', RIGHT page is blank. No new magic or activation.

Deep forest-teal framing, ivory hanji dialogue panel, warm restrained gold bevel and tactile material depth. Warm daylight on ruined stones, believable directional fur and textiles. Upper roughly70% artwork, lower dialogue with one speaker only. No cloudy decorative border; no settings, coin, logo, tab bar or invented icons. No poster captions or measurement labels. The dialogue panel and CTA must not cover any feet.

Main KO dialogue: '자, Mina 제자여, 오늘은 첫 글자부터 차근차근 살펴보세.'

Single GOLD primary button: 'Zurück in den Hof'

Preserve characters and scene logic over ornamental detail. Single full-screen illustration mockup, not a sheet, no device frame.
